scope: Compact scheduled feedback, keep Project edits as the only labeled workspace toolbar action, and require explicit activation to reveal starter details.

keep: Feedback ratings, payload, schedule, auth and validation
extend: Accessible icon names, focus restoration and responsive tests
replace: Full feedback send row with a corner icon
Hover and focus disclosure with click or keyboard activation
deprecate: Redundant toolbar text and feedback explanatory line

architecture.reason: Uses the existing feedback form, toolbar and anchored menu without adding a service.

auth.description: Existing feedback and share authorization is unchanged.

approval.description: Feedback still requires explicit submission; starter selection only edits a draft.

egress.description: Existing feedback payload and destination are unchanged.

cost.description: No new inference or provider usage.

tests.scope: Guard feedback submission and accessible names, toolbar labels and explicit starter activation.
Check actual feedback button position, toolbar text at desktop/mobile widths and no detail on hover.

rollout: Build and test a branch Preview before considering production.
rollback: Revert the UI changes or restore the previous frontend deployment. No data changes.

blockers: Browser verification and production release checks are required before promotion.
